purpose: Independent three-generation-seed confirmation of the unchanged P5 v1 scientific identity before protocol freeze.
repository_state_requirement: Run only from a clean committed Git worktree containing this preregistration.

model.configuration_policy: Use the official ddpm_cb_best values; bind only paths, CUDA device, generated row count, and declared generation seed at runtime.
model.checkpoint_policy: Train one new checkpoint and reuse its checksum-identical weights for all three generation seeds.

approve_protocol_freeze_if_all: one fresh training run completes from the pinned official configuration and upstream revision
exactly the preregistered generation seeds 3, 4, and 5 each produce 32561 decoded rows
all three tables pass the structural gate without evaluator repair
all three P5 bundles finalize successfully with all ten required metric identities and five evaluator seeds
source, configuration, checkpoint, synthetic-table, bundle, and execution checksums are retained
no row-level source, heldout, or synthetic table is committed
no numerical metric threshold, favorable-score filter, seed substitution, or rerun selection is applied
reject_or_defer_if_any: a declared identity or checksum drifts
a required run, table, metric, structural gate, or provenance field is missing
the environment differs from the preregistered Windows/Python/GPU identity
scientific parameters are changed after preregistration

claim_boundary: A successful run can support freezing the P5 metric protocol only. It cannot admit Adult, TabDDPM, a comparison track, a concrete result bundle, or another environment to Official Results; it cannot establish privacy or regulatory compliance.
